name: Claude Code on the web
gloss: A session in a cloud container on a fresh clone, started by you or by a Routine. Its work reaches main through a branch and a pull request; tracker state and filed errands it sets on main directly, as a Claude scheduled task does the Text occurrences snapshot.

name: Claude Code CLI or Cowork
gloss: A session on your own machine. What it changes sits in a local copy until it pushes.

name: Gemini through the laptop daemon
gloss: The daemon polls web-tools-private about once a minute. It writes topic summaries for new session records, and a ping a session filed goes to a Gemini agent that runs commands on the laptop, with the reply set in errands/results; since 2026-10-18 both are on the background branch. It also runs the scheduled-task registry's daemon rows, committing what a run changed to the repo the row's entry names, as the weekly job-board pull does to home. Its commits end in "via Gemini daemon"; earlier ones read as authored, and its sessions-cache refresh as the app's crawl.

name: Gemini in Antigravity
gloss: Google's Antigravity app on the home laptop, with Gemini as its agent. It works in a local clone and proposes on gemini/ branches. Its commits carry your git identity and a Co-Authored-By: Gemini trailer, so they read as authored.

name: Codex desktop app
gloss: OpenAI's Codex app on the home laptop. It works in a local clone and proposes on codex/ branches under your git identity, so its commits read as authored. A scheduled check in the app can poll a branch and push a reply, only while the laptop and the app are running.

name: scheduled-tasks workflow
gloss: Runs hourly on GitHub's machines, reads web-tools-private's scheduled-tasks registry, runs the statute check itself, and starts the other scheduled workflows when they are due.

name: activity-cache workflow
gloss: Refreshes the activity, file, document and session caches in web-tools-private's state/. Started hourly by the scheduled-tasks workflow, and by each push to web-tools main.

name: wsl-fetch workflow
gloss: Fetches the Legislature's bill data and sets the snapshot under pages/wsl-sync/data/ on web-tools main. Started monthly by the scheduled-tasks workflow, or by hand.

name: Web Tools app, cache refresh
gloss: The app rewrites its derived caches in web-tools-private's state/ when a tab opens and on Refresh.

name: Web Tools app, taps
gloss: An edit you make by tapping in the app or on one of its pages, such as a jot, a pin, a schedule edit, a page report, an errand closed, a proposal applied or files sent from the Stage. You decide what it contains; the app carries it. A proposal can land on a branch or as a draft pull request rather than on main.

name: Web Tools app, traffic log
gloss: The app writes a JSON file to web-tools-private's logs/traffic/ when a five-minute check of its own calls finds something worth reading: a call repeated, calls made while the tab was hidden, a failure, a large download, or the token's calls falling fast. A pattern filed within the hour on the same device is left out.

name: Phone shortcuts
gloss: Shortcuts on the phone set their run logs in web-tools-private through Log-Repo, a new file per run, run by hand or on an automation.

name: Session record hook
gloss: When a session goes idle, a hook sets the session's record in web-tools-private's sessions/.

name: Cloud turn activity hook
gloss: Cloud session hooks publish bounded prompt and response signals to the private background branch. Tool reports are throttled to thirty seconds, and newer timestamps win.

name: News fetch hook
gloss: When a session starts and the news ledger is two days stale, a hook fetches the feeds, appends to the ledger and rewrites its state file on home's main.

name: GitHub's website
gloss: GitHub's file editor and pull request page: an edit committed to main or to a new branch, or the merge that commits a reviewed branch to main.

name: git on your computer
gloss: Plain git in a clone, with no agent: what you change sits in the local copy until you push.

name: wayback-fetch workflow
gloss: Harvests a Wayback Machine URL corpus the sandbox cannot reach and sets it under projects/budget-drs/data/source/2026-08-02-wayback-url-corpora/ on home's main. Started by hand only, on purpose: a re-harvest rewrites a whole gzipped list.
